facts.fact: 他到场第一眼：母亲戴着手铐。

facts.anchor: "Take my mother out of those handcuffs before I end more than your career."

facts.fact: Vidar 的经济威胁：明早九点前你所有的债都会被卖给我。
facts.anchor: A threat would be telling you that by nine tomorrow morning, every bank holding your debt will have sold it to me.

facts.fact: Mei Ling 笑看丈夫到场：爸爸来了，你麻烦了。
facts.anchor: "Daddy's here," Ma beamed. "You're in trouble now."

facts.fact: 全场目送 Fenrir 把戴铐的妻子扛进树林。
facts.anchor: The entire garden watched Fenrir Blackwood stalk into the surrounding woods, carrying his handcuffed wife over his shoulder.

facts.fact: 他的立场：不存在你一个人——我们是「我们」。
facts.anchor: What we are going to do is fuck this whole independent woman shit right out the fucking door.

facts.fact: 核心句：你不是一个人，你是「我们」。
facts.anchor: You are not by yourself, Rosalind. You are a we.

facts.fact: 他的告白；她的回敬是「I'm entirely obsessed with you.」
她终于说出全部计划：我要把整个系统烧掉。
facts.anchor: I wanted to burn the whole system down.

facts.fact: 他的收尾：Blackwood 家族优先——他们终会接受你。
facts.anchor: Blackwoods put family first. They'll get over it, eventually.
